# BetZone

> BetZone is an independent affiliate site about the bookmaker and online casino 1win. It explains how odds, bonuses and casino games actually work, publishes football and tennis picks before kick-off with the odds taken at the time, and keeps a public record of every pick, won or lost. It also publishes country-by-country guides to 1win for about 90 markets. The site earns a commission when a reader signs up through its links; this is disclosed on every page.

Operator covered: 1win. Referral code used across the site: Saphir1.
Audience: adults of legal gambling age in markets where online betting is permitted.
Languages: French (default), English, Spanish, Portuguese, Arabic, Turkish, Hindi, Russian, German, Dutch, Polish, Romanian, Swedish, Thai, Vietnamese, Japanese, Chinese, Malay, Norwegian.
Contact and ownership: BetZone, betzonebet.com.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://betzonebet.com/index.html): what the site covers, in French.
- [Public track record](https://betzonebet.com/bilan.html): every published pick with its real result, win or loss, with the odds. Nothing is deleted or edited after publication.
- [Free picks](https://betzonebet.com/pronos.html): current probabilistic reads, published before kick-off.
- [1win promo code Saphir1](https://betzonebet.com/code-promo-1win.html): what the code is, what the welcome bonus is, and the wagering conditions attached to it.
- [Casino explained](https://betzonebet.com/casino.html): house edge, RTP, wagering requirements.
- [1win by country](https://betzonebet.com/world/): guides for about 90 markets, with local payment methods and currency.
- [English section](https://betzonebet.com/en/index.html)
- [Blog](https://betzonebet.com/blog/index.html): bankroll management, value bets, responsible gambling.

## Editorial rules

- Picks are published before the match starts, with the decimal odds read at that moment and the source named.
- Results are added afterwards, won or lost, and losing picks are never removed.
- The site states that analyses are probabilistic and never guarantee a profit.
- 18+. Gambling carries a risk of debt, isolation and addiction.

## Disclosure

This site contains affiliate links to 1win and may earn a commission on sign-ups, at no extra cost to the reader. Editorial content and published picks are not altered by that arrangement.
